note: Synthetic demo fixture. Untriaged raw public-source items consumed by the morning-brief pipeline. Headlines, sources, and URLs are invented for the demo. Includes one planted export-control item used by the M2 risk-scoring demo.

items.title: Draft export rules would expand licensing requirements for top-tier NVIDIA AI accelerators
items.snippet: A circulated draft of updated export-control rules would broaden licensing requirements for the highest-performance AI accelerators, with comment period closing this month. Scope language names accelerator classes shipped to additional regions.

items.title: NVIDIA partners with hyperscalers on next round of AI data-center buildouts
items.snippet: New co-design agreements cover rack-scale systems for data centers scheduled to come online next year, extending committed accelerator volumes.

items.title: TSMC capacity commentary points to tight leading-edge supply through next year
items.snippet: Checks indicate leading-edge wafer capacity remains fully booked, with allocation decisions favoring AI accelerator customers.

items.title: TSMC files monthly revenue disclosure showing record advanced-node mix
items.snippet: The latest monthly filing shows advanced nodes at a record share of revenue, consistent with sustained AI-related demand.

items.title: ASML receives follow-on order for next-generation lithography systems
items.snippet: A lead-edge customer placed a follow-on order for additional next-generation lithography tools, supporting capacity plans for sub-2nm nodes.

items.title: Analyst commentary: ASML order momentum supports multi-year visibility
items.snippet: Sell-side commentary aggregates order trends and suggests tool demand visibility now extends across multiple years of fab construction.

items.title: Vertiv announces expanded liquid-cooling order backlog for AI data centers
items.snippet: The company reported an expanded backlog for high-density cooling systems, citing AI rack-density requirements as the primary driver.

items.title: Constellation Energy signs additional data-center power agreement
items.snippet: A new long-term power purchase agreement adds contracted clean-energy load with a large data-center operator in the PJM region.

items.title: Constellation regulatory filing details uprate timeline for nuclear fleet
items.snippet: A regulatory submission outlines the timeline for capacity uprates across several units, with reviews expected to conclude next year.

items.title: Data-center REIT commentary highlights regional power constraints
items.snippet: Commentary from data-center real-estate operators flags grid interconnection queues as a constraint on new capacity in several regions.
